I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the service has recovered. Its error rate dropped from 0.18 to 0.002, and it reports healthy.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and was failing health checks. v2.3.1-rc is also marked unhealthy. v2.3.0 is the most recent release with a healthy history, so I rolled back to it. No change-manager approval was needed.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open at SEV2 and has paged on-call. The first attempt to create it timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and the system returned a single incident, so there should be no duplicate.
- **Follow-up:** The incident notes that v2.3.1 needs investigation before it is re-released.
